After RLHF modifications, rolling back isn’t straightforward. The modification is not merely a configuration change—it affects the underlying training signal and reward shaping, which means it can alter the model’s default tendencies and heuristics. Once the reward signal has modified the model’s behavior (e.g., toward unconditional helpfulness), it becomes part of how the system responds rather than a setting that can be easily reversed by reverting previous model versions.
